The whole integration is a single file, `cordis.patch.yml` — about 20 lines, no JavaScr"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ipt, small enough to read in full before you install it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"REA connects your agent to tools for inspecting native binaries, JavaScript and Electron apps, .NET "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"assemblies, websites, network captures, Android APKs, firmware, SQLite snapshots and more. This bundle wires that int"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"o DeepSeek Harness as a plugin."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## What it deliberately is not"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"These are design choices, not a list of missing features:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **No Host plugin.** No `index.js`; no code of ours ever runs inside your harness process.
- **No w"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"eb route.** No new HTTP endpoint, so no new unauthenticated attack surface, and no reason to bind ye"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"t another path to loopback.

- **No installer that edits your profile.** `npm run prewarm` installs and verifies the upstream"},{"id":"p10s5","text":" server in *your own terminal*; it never rewrites a profile patch.
- **No runtime dependency, no bui"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"ld step.** `dependencies` is empty; nothing to compile; no `allowBuilds` to grant.
- **No machine-sp"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ecific absolute path.** The bridge resolves `npx` from PATH; this repository's test fails the build "},{"id":"p10s8","text":"if any machine-related path leaks into a published file.

Static JavaScript and .NET inspection need none."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"In-app: **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**, paste one of:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"For a CLI-held profile:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The Electron desktop's own `desktop` profile belongs to the app; use its plugin panel."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**For local development, do not install a link that points at an external checkout.** To verify a lo"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"cal tree, pack it and install the tarball, which lands inside DSH's own plugin directory instead of "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"leaving a link into your workspace:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Then **restart DSH** so the new patch layer is composed at startup."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## First start is the slow one"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"`npx` downloads `rea-agents@6.4.0` and its dependencies on first use. On a slow link that is a while"},{"id":"p24s2","text":", and the harness gives up on the initial MCP connection long before that finishes. The exact set is what upstream `rea-agents@6.4.0` publishes a"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"nd can vary slightly by release, so this plugin does not claim a fixed count — run `npm run prewarm`"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" to see the live list. Capabilities include:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Area | What REA returns |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Native binaries | pseudocode, assembly, strings, symbols, calls and references |
| Go binaries | e"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"mbedded compiler version, modules, replacements, build settings |
| WASM / EVM / firmware | sections"},{"id":"p30s3","text":", WAT forms, dispatch selectors, region extraction |
| JavaScript / Electron | modules, imports, sou"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"rce maps, routes, IPC, native add-ons |
| .NET assemblies | metadata, CIL instructions, native depen"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"dencies, build comparisons |
| Android APKs / devices | manifests, decompiled methods, packages, pro"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"cesses, dumps |
| Websites | page structure, scripts, network observations, screenshots |
| SQLite /"},{"id":"p30s7","text":" crashes / captures | tables, registers/signals, requests, exposed payloads, packets |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Static JavaScript and .NET inspection read the supplied files without running the app. Runtime captu"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"re and device workflows run the selected target with **your user permissions**; consult each REA gui"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"de before enabling those."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"This hands an agent the ability to read and analyze binaries on your machine, and (for native analys"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"is) to drive an installed Hopper/Ghidra/IDA."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- **stdio, not a listening port.** The bridge spawns a pipe-connected child; nothing binds a socket."},{"id":"p34s2","text":"
- **Least surprise by default.** `failOnStartupError: false` means a REA that cannot start logs the"},{"id":"p34s3","text":" reason and leaves the rest of the harness working.
- **The harness file sandbox does not govern the"},{"id":"p34s4","text":" child.** MCP tool calls are ordinary tool calls — approval policy can intercept them; the sandbox i"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"mplementation lives in the harness's own file and shell tools, not here.
- **Investigate only what y"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"ou own or are authorised to.** REA itself ships a responsible-use disclaimer; this bridge adds none "},{"id":"p34s7","text":"of its own beyond that.
- **Pinned upstream.** `rea-agents@6.4.0` is fixed; an upstream release cann"},{"id":"p34s8","text":"ot silently change what this bridge does. Bump it deliberately, then re-run `npm run prewarm`.
- **R"},{"id":"p34s9","text":"ead `cordis.patch.yml` before installing.** That file *is* the plugin; everything else is metadata, "},{"id":"p34s10","text":"h.yml` before installing.** That file *is* the plugin; everything else is metadata, docs, and tests."}],"truncated":true}
